content.stem: 一个组织可以采取哪项行动来更好地了解其面临的扩散融资威胁？

options.A: 与一线部门合作,深入了解他们旨在扩大军事技术和军民两用产品市场份额的具体战略增长目标.
options.B: 审查组织的制裁风险评估,以更好地了解可能面临的与俄罗斯和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国相关的风险.
options.C: 阅读并分析由所在组织管辖区域内相关机构编制的最新《国家扩散融资风险评估》报告
options.D: 对所有向被认定为国防承包商的客户支付款项的交易进行详细审查,尤其要关注这些客户的实际受益人.

content.stem_en: Which action could be taken by an organization to better understand the threats faced from proliferation financing?

options_en.A: Work with the front line to understand strategic growth targets specifically aimed at increasing market share around military technology and dual-use products
options_en.B: Review the organization's sanctions risk assessment to better understand potential exposure to Russia and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea
options_en.C: Read and analyze the most recent National Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment produced by the relevant body in the organization's jurisdiction
options_en.D: Conduct a detailed review of transactions involving payments to all customers identified as defense contractors, paying particular attention to those customers' beneficial owners
